BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat the Dark Captain of Wind!!
Excuse me, adventurer?\nMaybe you're thirsty?
...I knew it.
I'm alright because I'm a soul. But you came to\nhere with your body, so I thought you might be\nthirsty or hungry...
Let's stop by the Dark Mirror and get some water\nand take a break...
This place is said to be especially beautiful\nin the Dark Domain.
It's called [Dark Mirror] because the sky is\nreflected on the surface of the water...
W-Whoaaa?! The Dark Mirror...\nW-What's goin' on...
The monsters seem to have dried up the lake...
F-For now, let's stop them drying up the lake\nand get the water. A-Alright?
S-Sir Zolban...?! What happened...
He's Sir Zolban the Dark Captain of Wind that\nSir Burnos was talking about...!! The black\ncrystals are just the same as the...
Oh, no! What are you doing?!\nSir, please stop it!
Otherwise, the Dark Mirror would be completely\ndried up!!
N-Noooooo!!
Guarrrggghhh!!
The crystals are... gone??
The black crystals on Zolban's body are gone.\nWhat happened...?
Umm... What was I doing...?\nWho's there...?
Oh, Sir Zolban!\nYou came to yourself!
You're Burnos' subordinate.\nWhat do you mean? I came to myself?
Yes, you were covered by something black and\nlooked horrible.
You looked like you were trying to dry up the\nlake using the monsters...
W-What?! The lake?!
Is it... Is it the Dark Mirror?! Dried up...?!\nI was using the monsters?! NO WAY!!\n...Oh, wait. What's the heck is going on?!
I parted from Halios at the Garden of Sublimation\nand I don't remember anything after stepping into\nthis place! No... This is terrible...
I've seen the black crystals many times in the\nhuman world... They seem to be able to parasitize\nliving things and control them...
And I'm sure that they have evil will...
!! Oh, Halios!\nI have no time for chatting!!
Are you alright?! I don't know if it's because of\nthe black stuffs but you seem you're severely\nwounded. Please don't push yourself too much...
Don't stop me. Sir Halios must be fighting at\nthe Garden of Sublimation ahead...\nI've gotta help him...
Argh! Damn...
You look like... a human, not a soul.\nWhy are you here?
...What? Grecia?
She's the Goddess of Courage. So, you're brave\nenough for her to save your life...\nThen, I'll ask you for help.
Go to the Garden of Sublimation for me and rescue\nSir Halios our commander...
Burnos' subordinate, you know how to go to the\nGarden of Sublimation, right? Guide this human.
Y-Yes, sir!
I'll head for the Garden of Sublimation when I get\nwell, so I'll leave him to you until then...
